action: The pillar of sunlight slams down onto the ground, the base ring flashes outward, motes and petals swirl up inside it, then it narrows and fades. Keep the same palette and style, transparent background.
seedPrompt: SUN PILLAR: a tall straight pillar of warm golden sunlight standing on a round sunlit patch of ground seen from an elevated three-quarter view, the pillar edged with crimson light, dust motes and paper petals floating inside, a bright ring of light on the ground at its base. Palette: shrine white (off-white), crimson, bell gold, warm sunlight yellow, pale rain blue. Ragnarok-inspired 2D MMORPG pixel art, hand-crafted look, consistent native pixel density, dark 1-pixel outlines, upper-left light, flat cel shading, no bloom, no soft gradients, no blur, few large readable shapes. Japanese Heian onmyodo and shrine maiden folk magic style: washi paper talismans with fictional brush strokes, folded paper, black and vermilion lacquer, eerie dignified yokai. NOT Thai, NOT Chinese, NOT Indonesian, NOT Slavic, NOT anime: no neon, no lens flare, no sparkle stars, no glowing crystals, no lightning, no torii gate, no pentagram or star shape, no taiji, no swastika or manji, no rising sun rays, no runes, no readable kanji or text, no religious symbols, no character, no person, no blood, no gore, transparent background, empty transparent margins on every side. Whites are warm washi off-white, never pure white.
